role: The village generator: one candidate per 32-chunk grid cell (min spacing 8) seeded through World.setRandomSeed(salt 10387312), allowed in plains, desert and savanna; the Start builds the well, roads and houses and is only generated when it has more than two non-road pieces.
scope_reason: villages = on in world.conf; SPEC Decisions 'Villages are on'.

members.name: terrainType
members.note: Fixed at 0; the superflat size option is not ported (n/a for default worlds).

members.name: MapGenVillage
members.note: Option-map constructor for superflat presets only.

members.name: canSpawnStructureAtCoords
members.note: Reseeds World.rand when the caller installs populate_world_rand, as Java's setRandomSeed does.

members.name: Start
members.note: The NBT-load constructor MapGenStructure.func_143027_a runs for each saved start: native rebuilds the start from its seeded candidate (the same pieces the saved Children were made from) and populate_restore_pieces overlays the saved state.

members.name: Start.func_143017_b
members.note: Valid is written once, by the constructor (var10 > 2 over the non-road pieces), and never changes, so the rebuilt start's start_sizeable equals the saved Valid. The pieces' saved state (each box, HPos, VCount, the once-set chest flag) comes back from the snapshot's structures.json, which Snapshot.java writes from the live structure map after any reload (what data/Village.dat gave): populate_restore_pieces, from serverreplay_load.
